description: This file defines a PHP class WebDriver which extends from Codeception e module. It is used in automated testing for browser interactions within the SuiteCRM project, specifically customizing or extending WebDriver functionalities for tests.

classes.name: WebDriver
classes.description: A specialized WebDriver class used in SuiteCRM testing, extending Codeception's WebDriver to add custom setup like window sizing and possibly other test-specific behaviors.

methods.name: initialWindowSize
methods.description: Initializes the browser window to a default size or configured size for tests.

methods.name: _afterSuite
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to perform cleanup or additional steps after test suite execution.

methods.name: waitForElementVisible
methods.description: Waits until a specific element is visible within a timeout period.

methods.name: waitForElementNotVisible
methods.description: Waits until a specific element is not visible within a timeout period.

methods.name: waitForText
methods.description: Waits until the specified text appears within a given element or area within a timeout.
